heard: You could fall into a black hole without noticing. A black hole the size of a city would shred you. One with the mass of our sun is just as deadly. Its point of no return is only about two miles wide. But supermassive black holes at galaxy centers are much gentler. You'd glide across the point of no return in seconds. From the outside, your friends see you turn red and freeze. Physicists Albert Einstein and Carl Schwarzschild solved the math in 1916. Gravity is so smooth there that everything seems fine.
